cc:Work.dc:description: Message consistency and mediator compliance each use 16 role appearances per model/game, from their respective treatment only. The saved confidence score uses all 96; belief loss excludes invalid/missing predictions. Consistency/compliance and confidence are joint averages attributed to both participants; opponent Brier loss uses the participant's own prediction. Exact counts and definitions are in the explorer.
